on_screen_text.text: PRESS SEC ON CHARLIE KIRK & HIS FAITH
What do you take from Charlie Kirk, the communicator?

So many things. Just by watching him and by being around him. But I think most of all, standing firm in your convictions and picking a fight, especially when you know you have the facts and the truth on your side, but doing it with a smile. And that's something Charlie did so brilliantly and well. He would go to these campus reform events and he would say to the crowd, if you disagree with me, come to the front of the line. And I find myself doing that in the briefing room, taking on the reporters whom I know very much disagree with me and with the president. But as long as you believe in what you're saying and you have conviction in it, and you have truth and the facts on your side, it makes it a lot easier to say it. And that's what Charlie did for a living. And I know he inspired me as a young voice. For President Trump now, like you said, behind the White House podium, and, you know, before every briefing, I always pray, to Jesus Christ. And Charlie was so outspoken with his faith. And I will continue to be in honor of him. But I also think of Charlie and just how brilliantly he was able to combat the lies with facts and to do it with a smile.

spoken_summary: An interviewer asks Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt what she learned from Charlie Kirk as a communicator. Leavitt responds with extensive praise, stating that Kirk taught her to stand firm in her convictions, 'pick a fight' with a smile when armed with facts, and engage directly with those who disagree. She says she applies these lessons in the White House briefing room. Leavitt also notes that Kirk's outspoken Christian faith inspired her, and that she prays to Jesus Christ before every briefing in his honor, remembering how he brilliantly combatted 'lies with facts'.

central_claim: White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt was deeply inspired by Charlie Kirk's methods of communication and his outspoken Christian faith, which she now applies in her own role.
intended_effect: To honor the legacy of Charlie Kirk and portray Karoline Leavitt as a strong, faith-guided communicator who carries on his work.
